entities.name: Mayael
entities.description: A female shaman and de facto leader of the Cylian elves on Alara, known on Naya as the Anima.

entities.name: Cylian elves
entities.description: Elves of Alara led by Mayael.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Mayael is called the Anima.

entities.name: Sacellum
entities.description: Temple crafted from living jungle trees where Mayael was named successor.

entities.name: Whitecover Gaze
entities.description: Ritual blinding the Anima in exchange for prophetic magical sight.

entities.name: Cylia
entities.description: The first Anima, who experienced Progenitus when Alara was sundered.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: Great hydra god of Naya consulted by Mayael.

entities.name: Relic of Progenitus
entities.description: Item Mayael used to call up Progenitus's spirit.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker present at the ritual who spoke against conflict.

events.summary: The dying previous Anima names Mayael her successor and has her undergo the Whitecover Gaze, blinding herself for magical sight.
events.quote: the Anima named Mayael as her successor

events.summary: During the ritual Mayael experiences the past lives of all previous Anima back to Cylia.
events.quote: Mayael experienced the past lives of all previous Anima

events.summary: Mayael journeys to the Valley of the Ancients and calls up Progenitus's spirit with the Relic.
events.quote: she called up the spirit of the beast and sought its advice

events.summary: A dark force disturbs the ritual; Mayael mistakes it for Progenitus and it demands the Cylian elves prepare for war.
events.quote: It demanded that the Cylian elves prepare for war.

events.summary: Ajani Goldmane speaks against conflict but is unheeded.
events.quote: Ajani Goldmane was present for this ritual and tried to speak against conflict

relations.quote: de facto leader of the Cylian elves from Alara

relations.note: seeks the wisdom of her god
relations.quote: so sought the wisdom of Progenitus

relations.note: successor in the line of Anima
